descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
A VR/MR pottery studio built exclusively for Meta Quest 3 / 3S.

Cup your hands around a spinning wheel and draw the clay upward. The clay follows your fingertips — the waist, the swell, the shape of the rim, all yours to form. When it feels right, decorate it with gosu, iron, and cinnabar pigments, dip it in a clear or Oribe glaze, and load the kiln. Every firing brings a one-of-a-kind kiln transformation (yohen): the glaze melts and settles into a living surface no two firings ever repeat.

Then carry your finished pieces into your real room with MR passthrough. Line them on a shelf, set them on your desk, and build a gallery that is yours alone. No locomotion, no hurry — a calm, seated, deeply immersive kind of making. A guided tutorial gently walks you through your first piece.

Fully offline. Nothing is collected or transmitted. Everything you make stays on your headset.
